category: hosted serverless TypeScript runtime with crons and HTTP endpoints

free_tier.stated: Free plan at USD 0: 100,000 runs / day, 15 min cron intervals, 1 min wall clock time / run, unlimited public vals, 3 days log retention, email to the account's own address and MCP integration
free_tier.notes: Free accounts have 0 private vals and 2,500 vals in all; the Val Town API takes 1,000 authenticated calls a minute; a worker has 4 GiB of memory.

per_object_cap.stated: 80,000 characters per source file in a val; 30 MiB per incoming email

retention.stated: 3 days of logs on the Free plan

egress.terms: not stated: the pricing and limits pages name no charge or cap on traffic out of a val

interface_detail: The REST API manages vals, blob storage, sqlite databases and other account resources, with a TypeScript SDK over it; vals also serve their own HTTP endpoints
tooling: the Val Town web editor, the REST API and its TypeScript SDK, and MCP integration
chaining: A cron every 15 minutes with up to one minute per run, free, serves as a heartbeat and poller for jobs on other hosts, with mail to the account owner as the alert path.

limits.value: minimum cron interval of 15 min per val

limits_note: Each run stops at 1 min of wall-clock time on the Free plan; a worker shuts down 10 seconds after its last request and lives at most 6 hours on any plan.
binding_note: The 15-minute minimum cron interval decides what can be scheduled; the 1-minute cap per run, in limits_note, decides what fits in one run.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page offers GitHub, Google or email; the form has no card field.
